title: Nearly invariant subspaces and weighted dual truncated Toeplitz operators
summary: Let $\mathcal{M}=h\mathcal{K}_u$ be a nearly $S^*$-invariant subspace of $H^2$, where $\mathcal{K}_u=H^2\ominus uH^2$ and $h$ is the extremal multiplier. For $\vp\in L^\infty(\T)$, we study the compression \[ D_\vp^\mathcal{M} = \restr{P_{\mathcal{M}^\perp}M_\vp}{\mathcal{M}^\perp}, \] called a weighted dual truncated Toeplitz operator. When $h\equiv1$, this reduces to the classical dual truncated Toeplitz operator.
